question: How many invoices are recorded, and what is their total value?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total FROM Invoice

question: Which three billing countries have the highest invoice totals?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total DESC, BillingCountry LIMIT 3

question: Which three genres contain the most tracks?
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track AS t JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY tracks DESC, g.Name LIMIT 3
